heroes.name: warrior
heroes.label: Warrior
heroes.blurb: Sword and board. High HP, taunts, soaks the front rank.

heroes.name: paladin
heroes.label: Paladin
heroes.blurb: Holy warhammer and consecrated shield. Heals on smite.

heroes.name: ranger
heroes.label: Ranger
heroes.blurb: Longbow, high crit, opens every fight from the back rank.

heroes.name: rogue
heroes.label: Rogue
heroes.blurb: Twin daggers and poison. Massive damage from stealth.

heroes.name: mage
heroes.label: Mage
heroes.blurb: Arcane staff. Hits every enemy, folds if anything reaches her.

heroes.name: cleric
heroes.label: Cleric
heroes.blurb: Restores the party and shrugs off curses. Mace for emergencies.

heroes.name: berserker
heroes.label: Berserker
heroes.blurb: Greataxe, no armour. Damage scales as his HP drops.

heroes.name: monk
heroes.label: Monk
heroes.blurb: Iron claws and footwork. Dodges, then counters twice.

heroes.name: necromancer
heroes.label: Necromancer
heroes.blurb: Raises the fallen. Every corpse on the field is a resource.

heroes.name: templar
heroes.label: Templar
heroes.blurb: Two-handed greatsword. Slow, enormous, cleaves the whole row.
